scripts.nx:affected: pnpm run env -- nx affected -t build
scripts.nx:dev: pnpm run env -- nx run-many -t dev
scripts.nx:build: pnpm run env -- nx run-many -t build
scripts.nx:prepack: pnpm run env -- nx run-many -t prepack
scripts.nx:test: pnpm run env -- nx run-many -t test
scripts.release:alpha: pnpm run env -- nx release --specifier prerelease --preid a --skip-publish && nx release publish --tag alpha
scripts.release:beta: pnpm run env -- nx release --specifier prerelease --preid b --skip-publish && nx release publish --tag beta
scripts.release:rc: pnpm run env -- nx release --specifier prerelease --preid rc --skip-publish && nx release publish --tag rc
